summary.text: A one-day-old male neonate born at 37 weeks by normal vaginal delivery to a mother with a previous spontaneous abortion weighed 1.340 kg, did not cry, had APGAR scores of 2 and 3 and severe perinatal asphyxia, received bag and mask ventilation, intubation and ventilator support, and died seven hours after birth. Examination showed multiple craniofacial and limb anomalies; echocardiography showed a ventricular septal defect and neurosonogram and fetal autopsy showed holoprosencephaly.

Karyotyping showed a mosaic ring chromosome 21 and chromosome 21 long-arm deletion; whole genome sequencing found a 15.2 Mb partial monosomy of 21q22.11-q22.3 spanning 505 genes and a reciprocal deletion and duplication on chromosome 19; the ring chromosome was not detected by WGS.
The source states two different causes of death: multiple congenital anomalies, and severe perinatal asphyxia (HIE grade 3).
